note: The 20-country WMH study is the primary source for expanded adult ADHD prevalence data. This file documents what we know and limitations.

recommended_next_steps: To get the 20-country data, someone with institutional access needs to download the Springer PDF and manually transcribe Table 1 (prevalence by country)
The 20-country study includes 10 additional countries beyond the original 10: likely includes Iraq, Japan, New Zealand, Northern Ireland, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Romania, and others
Alternative: contact the authors or check Harvard WMH data repository (www.hcp.med.harvard.edu/wmh) for public use data files
